identified_issues: Premature state machine progression: Task status transitioned to READY in the database prior to storage commit acknowledgement
Observability conflation: REST status API returns a proxy READY state without verifying physical artifact persistence in the storage cluster
Missing fail-closed error handling: Storage worker crash due to disk exhaustion was not captured or reflected in task lifecycle telemetry
Premature downstream side effects: Workflow advanced to SUCCESS and triggered billing invoices based on an unverified completion state
evidence: Artifact storage bucket contains no file named 'archive.zip' for 'task_991'
Storage backend worker crashed at block 4,096 due to disk exhaustion during write operation
Orchestrator received 'task_status': 'READY' from GET /api/v2/transforms/task_991/status despite missing file
Database state transition to READY occurred prior to storage commit confirmation, returning a static success payload
recommended_action: Refactor task state-machine transitions so that the READY status is strictly gated on two-phase confirmation or cryptographically verified object commit acknowledgement from the storage backend. Implement fail-closed crash detection to mark tasks as FAILED upon worker process termination, and cancel or void the premature billing invoice for task_991.
